paragraphs.text: Performer is an eternal creature type introduced in Unfinity . Performers are those who put on shows for entertainment and fun.
When introduced in Unfinity , performers functioned as the stars of Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun .
Dancer's Chakrams ( Final Fantasy Commander ) was the first card outside an Un-Set to reference the type. It adds the Performer type to creatures equipped with it.

There is currently no plan to update older cards (i.e., Radiant Performer ) with the creature type. It is unclear if the creature type will be adopted on upcoming eternal cards outside of un-sets or Universes Beyond .
Several Las Vegas themed Unknown Event playtest cards create performer tokens including Circus of the Sun , Jalira's Show , and Night Out in Vegas .

The Performer type has appeared in several Universes Beyond sets, including Marvel sets and Avatar: The Last Airbender , as the default type for actors and performers. It is also often used in conjunction with the Bard type for musical performers (e.g., The Mary Janes ), and in conjunction with the Warrior type for professional wrestlers (e.g., Professional Wrestler ).

Performers are common at Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun , with most workers giving some sort of performance to entertain guests . Types of performances vary greatly with examples such as balloon-making by Claire D'Loon , stunts by Devil K. Nevil , parades by Macie , singers like Harold , bug tamers like Jermane , puppeteering by Magar , and impersonation by Chennifer .
The top performers of the park are Myra's Marvels , who do a circus performance as a group.
